On the user's desktop OpenIDEA 0.1.40 the Laravel hub completed its first index after plugin Redémarrer, but after the project's User.php was rewritten externally the hub stayed on 'Indexing Laravel project… 17 of 69 indexing tasks complete', then on '1 of 2 indexing tasks complete' (the post-publish recheck queue, advance_index maintenance branch), for over 2 minutes with the window in front and the host process idle. Progress only moved when a tab click re-rendered the view. The headless released-host harness drives ticks itself and never reproduces this, so the stall is in how the desktop delivers the hub's index-tick polling or in a cancelled begin_task('Laravel') returning early, not in the per-call fuel budget. Not diagnosed further. Reproduced headlessly (scripts/runtime-smoke laravel binary with LARAVEL_SMOKE_STALL=1): after open-file and FilesChanged events the status stuck at '1 of 2' for 4000 ticks whenever the hub's opaque-message tick targeted a tab other than the plugin's active one, because ui_kit::web::handle rejects non-render operations on a grouped view whose targetView differs from the active view (Stale, 'the document changed in the meantime') before the plugin's index-tick handler runs. Fix: Main::handle advances the index as soon as an index-tick envelope arrives, before the grouped-view guard (index_ticks_advance_even_when_the_hub_envelope_targets_a_different_tab). All four tab targets now recover to ready in the harness. NOT confirmed as the desktop's cause: the desktop notification list showed no Stale warnings, and the reload of the fixed Wasm into the user's OpenIDEA was not completed (the Settings window misbehaved), so the stall on the desktop is not shown to be fixed. The rejected envelope still raises one warning notification per tick, which is a separate noise problem.
